evaluations.intakeText: JECFA determined that dietary exposure estimates to aspartame at the mean of up to 10 mg/kg bw per day for children and 5 mg/kg bw per day for adults, and for high dietary exposures up to 20 mg/kg bw per day for children and 12 mg/kg bw per day for adults, were appropriate for the present assessment. JECFA noted that these dietary exposure estimates do not exceed the ADI. JECFA therefore concluded that dietary exposure to aspartame does not pose a health concern.
